title: SSP-7.4 — Projects Publication Stage Evidence
summary: prove Projects-only Working, Pre-publish, Published and unavailable cues while removing its subject icons and preserving Analysis and Project State ownership
content_html:
SSP-7.4 — Projects Publication Stage Evidence

Outcome

SSP-7.4 implementation is complete and parked for manual presentation review. The private Projects manage manifest projects each current exact A-to-B row with B identity, current title, exact Manage URL, availability, and nullable publication evidence. The existing Projects browser contribution derives the presentation without storing a generic stage.

Presentation Contract

  • A Projects row with no exact B target shows Working.
  • Each available B without current public evidence shows 🟠 Pre-publish; each available B with current public evidence shows 🟢 Published. Mixed targets remain separate exact cues and link to their exact Manage documents.
  • A retained row whose exact B cannot be resolved shows ⚠️ Unavailable without choosing another target.
  • The projection never reads publishable. A still-public B remains green until successful Publish clears its public evidence.
  • Projects no longer renders Folder, Work, or Series row icons. Project State retains those icons and its clipboard text unchanged.
  • analysis/works and other public-capable scope reports receive no new stage cue. Their existing publishable: false exclusion icon remains unchanged.

Freshness Boundary

New/Replace Copy and changed successful-Publish reconciliation use the existing targeted sub-scope rebuild to refresh the exact lineage source collection after the small private table write. They add no endpoint, action, response field, receipt, retry, rollback, or broad scope/search rebuild.

Focused Evidence

  • 34 focused builder, customisation, lineage, Copy and Publish tests pass. They cover zero, one, several, mixed-stage, unavailable, exact Manage URL, private-only projection, unchanged publication evidence on republish, and exact source rebuild ownership.
  • The existing managed sub-scope browser module smoke passes. It proves Working, orange, green, unavailable, exact links, zero Projects subject icons, retained subject assignment/detail behavior, and unchanged Project State/module boundaries.
  • The live targeted dotlineform/projects rebuild covers 241 documents, rewrites only its manage manifest, and reports zero warnings.
  • Changed Python and JavaScript lint pass. git diff --check and final Studio Docs/search projection checks are recorded at this review gate.

Boundary Review

The diff changes only the existing private Projects manifest projection, Projects Manage contribution and styles, and the existing post-lineage targeted rebuild seams. It adds no Analysis presentation, Project State change, public payload, API, generic stage field, title/route inference, public mutation, or SSP-7.5 broad verification.

Stop here for manual Projects presentation review. Do not start SSP-7.5.
